title: Themes in African American Literature
description: An intensive examination of a characteristic theme, special issue, or period in African American literature. Program or materials fees may apply. May be taken for credit up to three times. Students may receive a combined total of twelve units for LTEN 185, LTEN 185GS, and ETHN 174.  Prerequisites:  department approval required. Students must apply and be accepted to the Global Seminars Program.
